name: Chapel
narrativeOnEnter: The institutional chapel. Rows of worn pews face a stone altar. A stained glass window — dark now — depicts something you can't quite make out. In the corner stands a bell mechanism: four handles, each connected by rusted wire to a bell above. A narrow door behind the altar is sealed with a heavy bolt.

hotspots.label: Maintenance Passage
hotspots.lockedMessage: A heavy bolt seals this door. The bell mechanism nearby might control it.

action.text:
A sheet of paper, folded carefully.

'The maintenance passage bolt is controlled by the bell sequence.
The pattern was agreed among staff who wanted a way out.

Pull the handles in this order:
Up, Down, Up, Down
(Handles 1, 2, 3, 4 — positions High, Low, High, Low)

The bolt will release after the correct sequence is played.'

A simple stone altar. A single candle — long since burned out — sits in the centre.

A small plaque is embedded in the stone:
'For those who could not leave.'

Below it, scratched with a nail: '1972. We tried.'

A large stained glass window. The light that might once have made it beautiful is gone — the boards outside block everything.

The image, barely visible: a figure standing before an open door. Whether they're entering or leaving is unclear.
